notes: Fixed a security issue: a backup or export imported from another app could contain hidden content that ran as code. Imported data is now cleaned everywhere it is displayed.
Your licence key is no longer included in exported backups. Until now, anyone you sent a backup to could read it straight out of the file.
The welcome screen, the guided tour and "try it with sample data" now work before a licence key is entered — previously they did nothing at all, and the welcome screen came back every launch.
Finishing the guided tour is now remembered, so it no longer replays every time you open the app.
The reminder to back up your data can now be dismissed on a copy without a licence key.
Read-only mode now applies from the moment the app opens, instead of a fraction of a second later.
The coach can now make tasks independent — try "make all Math AI HL tasks independent" to clear what they are waiting on.
The Coach page no longer goes blank if a saved suggestion is missing part of itself.
The coach no longer shows internal error text when it meets a change it does not recognise.
Notes, Subjects, Settings and University no longer go blank when a restored backup contains incomplete records.
Busy blocks saved without usable times are now ignored, instead of quietly reducing how much work Auto-Schedule could fit into your week.
The dialog for removing a licence key now says "Remove" rather than "Delete" — nothing is deleted.
